notes.title: Update 2.7.0
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/0994601a0e68bf4382c7afc09590e3b22eb66da2.png"][/img]🟢 [b]Total:[/b][/p][p]– fixed a bug with a Snake–Gorynych;[/p][p]– two divisions in Frontier mode, with high online levels, divisions do not transfer players between divisions so that novices leave with novices, and experienced ones with experienced ones;[/p][p]– in ARAM mode, with low online, instead of 5x5, there will be 3x3;[/p][p]– in ARAM mode, a vestibule has appeared, where there is an algorithm of random heroes available for the player to choose.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/b4934cd586deb69be68c5810b1a602aede79532a.png"][/img][/p][p]🟢 [b]The launcher:[/b][/p][p]– the mini-map in the vestibule has been updated, the position on the map will be displayed according to the side of your team - the Docts or the Adornians;[/p][p]– if the player has chosen a hero where there is no build or wants to change, then a "random build" from the hall of fame for this hero is now available right in the vestibule.;[/p][p]– Updated player stats in the castle: Now by entering your nickname in the search, you can see detailed information about yourself, and you can also view information about any player on the server.;[/p][p]– there will be internal game achievements in the new statistics;[/p][p]– the queue display has been moved by modes in the castle, as well as the display of your division (upper right corner);[/p][p]– each "queue" of a certain mode has its own Hall of Fame, according to this mode ("medals"), it will be available in a few days;[/p][p]– fixed the exit after the "theft of builds" from the hall of fame, now the transfer goes directly to the build in the castle, and not the old version of the launcher.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/b4934cd586deb69be68c5810b1a602aede79532a.png"][/img][/p][p]🟢 [b]Heroes and talents:[/b][/p][p]– The Intercessor / Guardian[/p][p]– The artist[/p][p]– Healer / Priestess[/p][p]– Virgo / Nymph[/p][p]– A blockhead[/p][p]– The bully[/p][p]– The Huntsman / Dancing with Wolves[/p][p]– Hunter / Shooter[/p][p]– The gunner[/p][p]– The Wanderer[/p][p]– The Berserker[/p][p]– Katana[/p][p]– The doctrine[/p][p]– Asur[/p][p]– The fanatic[/p][p]– The Plague Doctor[/p][p]– Kara[/p][p]– Soul Reaper / Soulcatcher[/p][p]– Fix / Fairy Queen[/p][p]– The shaman[/p][p]– The Pied Piper[/p][p]– The traveler[/p][p]– Amazon[/p][p][/p][h3]Подробнее о ребалансах (изменениях) по ссылке:  [url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DbAz8FDk0EFFyM4LYGg4ihUoh4NBFMSNSjEiigAjDDA/edit?tab=t.vxcfbu1acghm"]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DbAz8FDk0EFFyM4LYGg4ihUoh4NBFMSNSjEiigAjDDA/edit?tab=t.vxcfbu1acghm[/url][/h3]

notes.title: New ARAM Mode Rules
notes.content:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/a15dbf511248c64b60f3376057d04a7a857d41e3.jpg"][/img][b]👉 [/b]New ARAM rules:[/h2][p]—  there are 15 random heroes available in the vestibule, have time to pick up the best among them to make your team's peak stronger than the enemy's;
— you can use your builds or generate a random build from the Hall of Fame for any hero right in the vestibule.[/p][p][i]‼️  [/i]The ARAM victory rating has been temporarily increased by 25% compared to the Borderlands.[/p][p][b]ARAM[/b] — is a dynamic 5x5 battle on a single line without a forest and with fast leveling of heroes. In ARAM, you cannot restore the hero's health at the main base.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 2.6.10
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/0baf5b88523316636b16217b9661eb925cc027d8.jpg"][/img][b]🟢 Total:[/b][/p][p]– fixed the problem when saving camera settings was lost, now it will work correctly (thank you for the information provided by the PW Legends server);[/p][p]– synchronized chats from the castle and telegram topics "Ether", writing in one chat, your message will appear in the other and vice versa;[/p][p]– those who have played with VPN can try to play without it, we have updated some details on the server operation.;[/p][p]– offensive nicknames will now turn into IDs. To remove the block from the nickname, it is enough to contact support, the administration. That you have changed your name (write id).[/p][p], The launcher:[/p][p]– the search lock has been removed after not confirming the found fight.;[/p][p]– if you have not confirmed the choice of the hero in the vestibule, you will receive an increased ban for AFK with an interval of 5 minutes and up to 15 (previously there was an interval of 1 minute and up to 5). If you are banned for AFK in the vestibule, you can continue to play other game modes where there is no vestibule (Outpost, Dragonwald, ARAM, Duel);[/p][p]– if you received a search ban and then left and played a battle in Frontier mode, the ban is automatically reset.;[/p][p]– updated links in the lock (settings) to support chats.
[/p][p][b]🟢 Heroes and talents:[/b][/p][p]– set of "Pirate Adventures"[/p][p]Fixed a bug with the Pirate's set. The set now correctly increases the attack range if you study it after death.;[/p][p]– In the form of a bear, the Witcher hero's Pirate Adventures set now increases the hero's evasion, and in human form, the attack range.;[/p][p]- fixed a bug where the Asura hero in a purple stance did not deal damage from a tackle to a target that was running at him.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 2.6.0
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/54a45e592e478eb86064ce4347469fd9ad82e129.png"][/img]We added about 100 divisions to the Frontier game mode, but limited ourselves to just two during testing. Depending on your skill level, you will be assigned to one of two divisions.: 
[i]— Private rank;
— The General.[/i]

The time to search for a fight may increase, but you will play with more equal opponents.

ːsteamthumbsupː  Matchmaking algorithms for selecting players divide everyone into divisions. The skill level is determined based on the combat statistics and individually for each player.

We are also starting to analyze your behavior in the game. Now each account has a karma indicator. This mechanism analyzes your actions in the game and identifies unsportsmanlike behavior, namely:[/p][p][i]— exit from the game (liv);[/i][/p][p][i]— non-participation in the game process (AFC);[/i][/p][p][i]— deliberate death of your hero at the hands of the enemy (feed);[/i][/p][p][i]— endless "Zoom".[/i]

ːsteamthumbsupː Systematic unsportsmanlike behavior will lead to a rapid decrease in "karma." In the process of adapting the system, this indicator will be used by the administration to make decisions on banks based on complaints.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/8c2f9582f5acc725a55cb2556b124a6e5c4e07c7.png"][/img]

🟢 General:[/p][p]— Activation of divisions in the frontier game mode;[/p][p]– added a mechanism for analyzing user behavior in the gameplay;[/p][p]– added a mechanism for tracking "twink" accounts;

🟢 The launcher:[/p][p]— output the number of players in the queue for all game modes;[/p][p]— output of the "karma" indicator before starting the search for a fight;[/p][p]— withdrawal of the division before the start of the search for combat;[/p][p]— added partial support for the "English" language;[/p][p]— added partial support for the Belarusian language;[/p][p]— automatic language change depending on the operating system settings;[/p][p]— closing the Steam authorization window after successful login (fixed);[/p][p]— added account lock verification on the Steam authorization form (fixed).

🟢 Game modes. General changes:[/p][p]— added changes to the workout mode;[/p][p]— added changes to forest packs in Frontier mode;[/p][p]— changing the Zoom operation;[/p][p]— changes in the mechanics of the Snake - Gorynych's work.[/p][p]🟢 Heroes and talents:[/p][p]— Akshar/A vampire;[/p][p]— Asur;[/p][p]— Faceless / White Mask[/p][p]— The Witcher/Forester;[/p][p]— Blizzard / Cryo;[/p][p]— Daka / Haka;[/p][p]— Virgo / Nymph;[/p][p]— The Dryad;[/p][p]— The Duelist/Prince of Thieves;[/p][p]— Soul Reaper / Soulcatcher;[/p][p]— The Intercessor/Guardian;[/p][p]— Engineer/Inventor;[/p][p]— Katana;[/p][p]— Kara;[/p][p]— The gunner;[/p][p]— The fang/The Claw;[/p][p]— The Pied Piper / Lord of the Rats;[/p][p]— Honey cooker;[/p][p]— Moira/The Witch[/p][p]— The Fallen Lord;[/p][p]— The leader/The Governor;[/p][p]— The bomber;[/p][p]— The Wanderer;[/p][p]— The shooter/Hunter;[/p][p]— Dancing with wolves / Huntsman;[/p][p]— The shadow / The Invisible Man;[/p][p]— Frieze;[/p][p]— The Queen of the Night / Black Panther;[/p][p]— Chimera/Genomorph;[/p][p]— The artist / Paint;[/p][p]— The bully;[/p][p]— The Chronicle;[/p][p]— The Enchanter/The Magosaurus;[/p][p]— Mountain Man / Roar;

1. closing the window after authorization via steam
2. automatic change of language in the lock depending on the localization of the OS system (check required)
3. displaying players in queues for all modes in the drop-down list of modes.

notes.title: Updating network connections
notes.content:
* The game client has been reassigned to a different port (in the range of Steam ports). Connections for players who previously used RadminVPN to connect are expected to be fixed (you will need to uncheck the box in the menu)
* Another domain name with a neutral name has been added. Connection errors for players who continue to use VPN services are expected to be fixed.
* The mechanism for connecting players when entering the castle has been improved. Now the first available server will be selected as the starting connection server. This will improve the responsiveness of the castle for all players

notes.title: Visual edits
notes.content: Removed visual displays of errors that are not necessary to avoid confusing players

notes.title: Fixed a visual bug with choosing RadminVPN priority
notes.content: Now if the checkbox is checked, the connection via RadminVPN will be prioritized if it is installed and connected.
